mbdefaults.name: mbdefaults
mbdefaults.purpose: Set and list the default MBIO control parameters in ~/.mbio_defaults
mbdefaults.keys_comment: No data input; the current or new defaults are listed on stdout.

mbdumpesf.name: mbdumpesf
mbdumpesf.purpose: Dump an MB-System edit save file as an ascii table
mbdumpesf.keys_comment: Primary input is the edit save file given with -I; the table goes to stdout.

mbnavlab2fnv.name: mbnavlab2fnv
mbnavlab2fnv.purpose: Convert Kongsberg Navlab smoothed navigation to MB-System fnv navigation
mbnavlab2fnv.keys_comment: Primary input is the Navlab file given with -I; the fnv file is written by the module itself.

mbusbl2fnv.name: mbusbl2fnv
mbusbl2fnv.purpose: Convert USBL ROV tracking CSV to MB-System fnv navigation
mbusbl2fnv.keys_comment: Primary input is the USBL CSV file given with -I; the fnv file is written by the module itself.

mbfnv2navlab.name: mbfnv2navlab
mbfnv2navlab.purpose: Convert MB-System fnv navigation to a Kongsberg Navlab smoothed navigation file
mbfnv2navlab.keys_comment: Primary input is the fnv file given with -I; the Navlab file is written by the module itself.

mbroutetime.name: mbroutetime
mbroutetime.purpose: List the times when a survey reached the waypoints of a planned route
mbroutetime.keys_comment: Primary input is the swath file or datalist given with -I; the waypoint times are written to the -O file.

mbrolltimelag.name: mbrolltimelag
mbrolltimelag.purpose: Estimate the roll time lag from swath bathymetry
mbrolltimelag.keys_comment: Primary input is the swath file or datalist given with -I; results are written to files by the module itself.

mbsegylist.name: mbsegylist
mbsegylist.purpose: List table data from a segy file
mbsegylist.keys_comment: Primary input is the segy file given with -I; the table goes to stdout.

mbsegypsd.name: mbsegypsd
mbsegypsd.purpose: Calculate the power spectral density of each trace of a segy file as a grid
mbsegypsd.keys_comment: Primary input is the segy file given with -I; the grid is written by the module itself.

mbsegygrid.name: mbsegygrid
mbsegygrid.purpose: Grid trace data from segy files
mbsegygrid.keys_comment: Primary input is the segy file given with -I; the grid is written by the module itself.

mbauvloglist.name: mbauvloglist
mbauvloglist.purpose: List table data from an MBARI AUV mission log file
mbauvloglist.keys_comment: Primary input is the log file given with -I; the table goes to stdout.

mb7k2jstar.name: mb7k2jstar
mb7k2jstar.purpose: Extract Edgetech subbottom and sidescan data from Reson 7k data into Jstar format
mb7k2jstar.keys_comment: Primary input is the 7k file or datalist given with -I; Jstar files are written by the module itself.

mbminirovnav.name: mbminirovnav
mbminirovnav.purpose: Merge MBARI MiniROV USBL tracking and CTD day files into ROV navigation
mbminirovnav.keys_comment: The input day files are named by long options; output files are written by the module itself.

mbmakeplatform.name: mbmakeplatform
mbmakeplatform.purpose: Create or modify an MB-System platform file
mbmakeplatform.keys_comment: Inputs and the platform file are named by long options and handled by the module itself.

mbsslayout.name: mbsslayout
mbsslayout.purpose: Lay out raw sidescan time series on a topography model
mbsslayout.keys_comment: Inputs are named by long options; the laid-out swath files are written by the module itself.

mbnavadjustmerge.name: mbnavadjustmerge
mbnavadjustmerge.keys_comment: Projects are named by long options and written by the module itself.
